scope: Observed production failures and bounded repairs. Retrieval aids judgment; it does not establish weaker-model competence.

entries.symptom: A scene cue matches multiple spoken phrases, or none.
entries.cause: Short cue prefixes recur in the narration; punctuation and case are normalized.
entries.repair: Extend each literal self.at phrase until it identifies one intended occurrence. Run compile_cues.py --project PROJECT --check-only before synthesis; run without --check-only after synthesis.
entries.verify: Preflight reports unique script matches; measured compilation succeeds; inspect the actual transition against speech.
entries.avoid: Do not silently choose the first match or use script token positions as measured seconds.

entries.symptom: An outline becomes a solid shape after dimming or restoring it.
entries.cause: Changing opacity for the entire object also changes fill opacity.
entries.repair: For outline-only objects, change stroke opacity explicitly and retain fill opacity zero. Restore stroke opacity rather than setting every opacity to one.
entries.verify: Render the dimming and restoration interval; inspect both endpoints and an intermediate frame.
entries.avoid: Do not treat render success as evidence that the original geometry remains visible.

entries.symptom: Two compared numbers sound like one number; a standalone letter is misrecognized.
entries.cause: Forty thousand and nine can mean40009. Spoken A can resemble an article or another vowel.
entries.repair: Name each quantity separately: forty thousand for the first example, compared with nine for the second. Use an unambiguous referent such as the example on the right when appropriate. Update narration and captions together.
entries.verify: Read independent full-source ASR and investigate mathematical differences. Listening, if available, checks pronunciation; ASR alone does not establish natural prosody. Recompile timing after changed speech.
entries.avoid: Do not waive a changed mathematical value because the overall transcript similarity is high.

entries.symptom: An old render or review remains on disk after an input changes.
entries.cause: Files existing on disk do not prove their inputs match the current project.
entries.repair: Read engine status. Rebuild invalidated audio, timings, scenes and assembly in dependency order. Generate evidence for the new export hash and inspect it.
entries.verify: Current snapshot and evidence hashes match; mechanical verification succeeds; reviewer attests only to inspected current media.
entries.avoid: Never copy a previous acceptance onto a new export or delete receipts to force publication.

entries.symptom: A command reports production held by a PID.
entries.cause: Another operation owns this project's lock; independent-looking operations can share artifact state.
entries.repair: Inspect the existing job and let it finish, then retry the dependent command. Parallelize across independent projects where resources permit.
entries.verify: Job status indicates completion and the next command acquires the lock normally.
entries.avoid: Do not remove a live lock or launch repeated workers for the same project.

entries.symptom: A graph appears to contradict a numerical distance comparison after changing units.
entries.cause: The physical locations, coordinate labels and on-screen axis scales are different quantities.
entries.repair: Declare what is held fixed. If locations stay fixed while labels convert, identify the changed display scale. Compute raw and normalized distances independently.
entries.verify: Each displayed point, label and numerical comparison agrees with the declared mapping throughout the transition.
entries.avoid: Do not stretch an illustration silently or claim standardization is universally beneficial.

entries.cause: The upload endpoint rejected the daily quota; this differs from an uncertain upload outcome.
entries.repair: Preserve the receipt. Honor retry_not_before and resume the same batch afterward. Continue independent authoring or tooling work during the wait.
entries.verify: Read-only publication_status verifies actual visibility and successful processing before counting completion.
entries.avoid: Do not bypass the limit with another project, blindly duplicate an uncertain upload, or assume every429 is a daily quota.

entries.symptom: The source contains a fix but the installed host uses old tools.
entries.cause: A versioned plugin cache was not refreshed; an unchanged manifest can be reported as latest.
entries.repair: Use the host's documented version/update flow. Resolve the actual installed cache path and compare representative files with source. Start a fresh host session afterward.
entries.verify: Installed files match the intended revision and its engine runs from an unrelated working directory.
entries.avoid: Do not equate a successful install command with a tested filmmaking model.

entries.symptom: An old answer or conclusion remains under changed inputs during an animation.
entries.cause: The animation updates one representation without updating or hiding dependent claims.
entries.repair: Track every dependent visible value. Update it consistently, hide it until recomputed, or label separate before and after states. Retain old algorithm inputs until both new values are computed.
entries.verify: Inspect immediately before, during and after the change, including any return to the earlier state; compare all visible claims with independent mathematics.
entries.avoid: Do not infer temporal correctness from correct endpoints or overall render success.
